programs/task-a11139f5.py
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max({v for row in grid for v in row},key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        for y,x in q:
          comp.append((y,x,grid[y][x]))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        comps.append(comp)
    motif=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(y for y,x,v in motif); r1=max(y for y,x,v in motif)
    c0=min(x for y,x,v in motif); c1=max(x for y,x,v in motif)
    cr=(r0+r1)//2; cc=(c0+c1)//2
    rel=[(y-cr,x-cc,v) for y,x,v in motif]
    for comp in comps:
      if comp is motif or len(comp)!=1: continue
      r,c,_=comp[0]
      for dy,dx,v in rel:
        yy,xx=r+dy,c+dx
        if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w: out[yy][xx]=v
    return out
